method: Each check breaks one thing the lot added, in an isolated copy of 4918948d plus W-0364 and this lot, rebuilds the project the named tests live in, runs them, and writes the original bytes back (never git checkout). Every named test must fail and the named neighbour must stay green; the operator-tool check changes one letter offset in tools/ops/production-pilot-list.mjs and requires production-pilot-selftest.mjs to fail. Controls run after restoring: the unit tests of the production gate, the trunk and the Asterisk gateway, the five integration TestIds, and the tool's self-test. The checks ran before the lot was carried onto W-0365; the carried-over files are re-verified in the README.
